item.title: Alcaraz dents Djokovic’s Melbourne final perfection, wins first Australian Open title
item.description: Carlos Alcaraz forged a Melbourne milestone to secure tennis history on Sunday night at the Australian Open. item.description: Carlos Alcaraz defeated Novak Djokovic in the championship match of the Australian Open on Sunday to extend his lead over his great rival Jannik Sinner in their Big Titles battle. item.description: There is stunning history that ties together the first Australian Open titles of Carlos Alcaraz, Rafael Nadal and Roger Federer.
